summary:
The story tells the tale of two twin robots, Spirit and Opportunity, who dream of traveling to Mars to explore its landscapes and discover possible evidence of ancient life. During their space mission, an accident occurs that separates them, forcing each one to explore a different region of the planet.

Throughout the story, both face dangers, difficulties, and discoveries. Spirit and its team investigate ancient terrains and find signs that water may have once existed on Mars. Meanwhile, Opportunity continues its exploration for many years, overcoming various obstacles until it finds the place where its brother, Spirit, was located. Finally, both are remembered as heroes for their bravery and dedication.
details: Our project is an interactive web-based video game called MER project, which works by challenging players to interact and make decision. This game offers significant benefits by providing an engaging, accessible form of entertainment while actively helping users develop. The expected impact of the project is to reach infant to demonstrating how lightweight browser-based applications can deliver meaningful digital experiences without requiring complex installations. To develop this project, our team utilized web development technologies including HTML and visual studio code. Our project is particularly creative in the way it combines imagination and take decisions that change your point of view into a single self-contained file. Finally, throughout development, our team carefully took into account key factors such as user interface intuitiveness, balanced difficulty progression, smooth frame-rate performance, and cross-browser compatibility to ensure a reliable experience for every player.
